positions.name: KnowledgeRemovalDirectives
positions.frame: what knowledge domains are subject to removal or forgetting directives?
positions.why: Both expressions are directives from Xena ExpertGH commanding the removal or forgetting of specific knowledge domains — the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts (src-1), and zeppelin routes (src-2). They cohere under the directional read of what knowledge the organization is directed to purge, with no tension between them.
